concepts.gloss_en: "bara" (created) — the Hebrew verb from "Bereishit bara," aspect of creation / the revealed / the half-utterance / lower level
"bara" (son, Aramaic) — from the dictum "bra kar'a de-avuha" (a son is the leg/extension of his father)

reason_for_human: Three occurrences in LM 1:22 are clearly the Hebrew בָּרָא 'created' (paired with תורה/בן, glossed as 'the entirety of creation' vs. Bereishit). The fourth (LM 2:81, partner כרעא) is the Aramaic homograph בְּרָא 'son' from the saying 'bra kar'a de-avuha' (son is the father's leg) — a different word, so I split it off.
